|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 2. Your ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers deploy - 2 to same system.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Admiral Motti (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers are deploy -2 to same system.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 2. Your” → “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.”; added “are”; “- 2” → “-2”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 26. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Admiral Motti]].
